# Generate nitride compositions
import json

# Common elements that form nitrides
elements = [
    'Li', 'Na', 'K', 'Rb', 'Cs',  # Alkali metals
    'Be', 'Mg', 'Ca', 'Sr', 'Ba',  # Alkaline earth metals
    'B', 'Al', 'Ga', 'In',  # Group 13
    'Si', 'Ge', 'Sn',  # Group 14
    'Ti', 'Zr', 'Hf',  # Group 4 transition metals
    'V', 'Nb', 'Ta',  # Group 5 transition metals
    'Cr', 'Mo', 'W',  # Group 6 transition metals
    'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',  # 3d transition metals
    'Y', 'La', 'Ce', 'Pr', 'Nd',  # Rare earths
    'Sc', 'P', 'As'  # Others
]

compositions = []

# Binary nitrides (X-N)
for elem in elements[:40]:  # Limit to 40 to match max_compositions
    compositions.append(f"{elem}-N")

print(f"Generated {len(compositions)} nitride compositions")
for i, comp in enumerate(compositions[:10]):
    print(f"{i+1}. {comp}")

with open('/home/alamparan/corral/ml/WORK_DIR_2/ml_nitrides_trial_2/compositions.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(compositions, f, indent=2)

print(f"\nSaved {len(compositions)} compositions to compositions.json")

# Generate a list of nitride compositions
import json

# Common elements that form nitrides
elements = ['Li', 'Na', 'K', 'Mg', 'Ca', 'Sr', 'Ba', 'Al', 'Ga', 'In', 'Si', 'Ge', 'Sn', 
            'Ti', 'Zr', 'Hf', 'V', 'Nb', 'Ta', 'Cr', 'Mo', 'W', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 
            'Cu', 'Zn', 'B', 'C', 'P', 'As', 'Sb', 'Sc', 'Y', 'La', 'Ce', 'Pr', 'Nd']

nitride_compositions = []

# Binary nitrides (MN, M2N, M3N, M3N2, M3N4, etc.)
for elem in elements:
    nitride_compositions.append(f"{elem}N")
    nitride_compositions.append(f"{elem}2N")
    nitride_compositions.append(f"{elem}3N")
    nitride_compositions.append(f"{elem}3N2")
    nitride_compositions.append(f"{elem}3N4")
    nitride_compositions.append(f"{elem}N2")

# Remove duplicates and limit to 40
nitride_compositions = list(set(nitride_compositions))
nitride_compositions = nitride_compositions[:40]

print(f"Generated {len(nitride_compositions)} nitride compositions")
print(nitride_compositions)

# Save to file
with open('/home/alamparan/corral/ml/WORK_DIR_2/ml_nitrides_trial_4/nitride_compositions.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(nitride_compositions, f, indent=2)
